content.short: Ethereum World unifies the ecosystem by integrating decentralized apps into a simple, delightful social experience.
content.description: Ethereum World creates a social space that unifies the Ethereum ecosystem by weaving together decentralized apps into a simple, delightful social experience. Users stay connected with their community through posts on their timeline, and can discover, participate in, or start meaningful conversations. It is a place to explore diverse topics, share updates, and interact with others who are building and using decentralized applications within the Ethereum ecosystem.
content.meta: Ethereum World is a Web3 social app that unifies the Ethereum ecosystem. Discover Ethereum World and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
